lines.en: One paw snaps the brush down
My weight packs the leaves flat
I walk the edge of the forest
My claws sink into soft earth
I roll forward heavily
I step over a fallen trunk
I rub past a tree trunk
My shadow is broad
I walk step by step toward the open
I flatten a fern patch
I lift my head into the wind
I roll steadily onward
I kick a stone aside
I reach the clearing at the treeline
I make my way down a bank
I sit down and scratch
I rub my back on a tree
My nose keeps twitching
I rear up to look around
I paw a hollow in the ground
I yawn widely
I turn my head slowly
My ears are twitching
I rest against a pine
I sniff at a flower
I sit like a boulder
I bat a pine cone about

lines.zh: 我在树干上挠出一道新痕。
lines.en: I scratch a fresh mark into the trunk.
I listen to the forest quietly
I raise my head at you
You are standing in my woods
You are not from these woods
Leave the sweet berries and I'll go.
I do not move off at once
Your hands smell unfamiliar
Are you looking for a path
I edge another half step in
My ears turn your way
I growl once in warning
I shake my head

lines.zh: 我的前掌在土里划出印子。
lines.en: My forepaw leaves a gouge in the dirt.
That made me angry
I claw at the ground
My fur has risen
I huff out a breath
I lick where it hurts
What berries are those

lines.zh: 浆果的汁水顺着你的手指流。
lines.en: Berry juice runs down your fingers.
Those are small red fruit
I do not often eat that
You set them on the ground
I lower my head and sniff
I eat them and settle down
That sweetness calms me
I would like a little more
Give me those and I will not growl
I ease up to your hand
I sit and wait for you to set it down
I chew until my mouth is stained purple.
I finish and look up at you
Your hand still smells sweet
I lower my head to sniff your hand
You hit me like hitting a tree
I am nudged aside
My weight pushes you off
I block you with a paw
We both stop
I grunt and move off
Your hat fell off

lines.zh: 撞我一下，甜浆果也救不了你。
lines.en: Bump me once and sweet berries won't save you.
There are other bears deeper in

lines.zh: 我闻到了一只母熊的味
lines.en: I smell a she-bear
I head along the gully that way
I claw a mark in a trunk
We share this stretch of woods
I take such things slowly
No hurry, I have the seasons
Her prints are smaller than mine
I leave the bark marks there
I come back to my own ground
I push the leaves aside and take it
I mouth it and chew
I bat it against a trunk
I flip it with a claw
This is not food
I carry it a few steps
I drop it in a hollow
I sniff it and put it down

lines.zh: 我把它压在自己的窝边
lines.en: I press it by my den
It does not interest me
I heard a branch crack
I turn to face that way
I do not like that smell
You have spoiled my path
My claws dig into the soil
I take two steps toward you
The birds have all flown
Your iron smell is too strong
I follow your scent
You went behind that tree
I follow, step by step

lines.zh: 你踩断的枝子告诉了我
lines.en: The twig you broke told me
I do not run, I come slowly

lines.zh: 我在等你离开我的林子
lines.en: I wait for you to leave my woods
My ears stay pointed at you
My shadow is nearly on you
There is no path where you are going
I sweep a paw across
I rear up and bear down
I shove you backwards
My claws tear your clothes
I ram your chest
That swipe carried my whole body
I press you to the ground
You guard your head and bare a shoulder
The bushes shake once
A dark shape joins the woods
The leaves rustle under me
I set a front paw down
A bear rises under the tree
The wind moves my fur
I catch a new smell
I ease out of the tree shadow
Fire singes a patch of my fur
The landing stuns me
The blast rolls me over
Magic leaves me numb all over
Hunger slows me down
The strike buckles my legs
I claw at nothing as I fall
